# Science and Math with Mrs. Lau

> Educational resource platform by MIT-trained educator Bethany Lau offering doodle diagram notes, interactive diagrams, and professional development for high school science teachers.

Science and Math with Mrs. Lau (SWML) provides visual learning resources and curriculum materials for biology and chemistry classrooms. The site combines Bethany Lau's teaching expertise with innovative doodle diagram methodology to help teachers engage students through interactive, illustrated study materials.

## Key Topics

- Doodle Diagram Notes
- Biology curriculum
- Chemistry resources
